envelope.description: Prove installation rollout matrix and complete focused verification

body.title: Prove installation rollout matrix and complete focused verification
body.summary: Run the final daemon/controller/source/index/planned/planless/native/legacy installation matrix, actual adapter qualification diagnostics, focused suites and production build; retain required sequence documentation and one final independent code review.
acceptanceChecks: Matrix covers capability mismatch, both installation orders, scope ambiguity, unknown impact/usage, concurrency, crash/reconnect and rollback without legacy/design regressions.
Installed adapter qualification is reported truthfully; an unsupported binary or pending reconciliation leaves opt-in closed rather than manufacturing readiness.

Focused affected suites and production build pass without whole-repo/live sweeps; record logs in /tmp, update relevant diagram if integration changes its boundaries, and run exactly one mandatory independent code review before asking BUILD completion approval.
Final BUILD distinguishes completed implementation from activation readiness, listing any unsupported installed adapter or separately pending reconciliation approval explicitly.

tests.name: Installed adapter and activation readiness remain explicit across the final matrix
Focused production integration domain legacy provider fixtures and production build
